description: Praline box locator: finds where the grid of praline slots sits in the photo, using the printed ruler.

fieldSchema.name: PralineGrid
fieldSchema.description: A top-down photo of an open praline box, with a white margin and a 0-100 RULER printed on all four sides (0 = photo's left/top edge, 100 = right/bottom edge). The ruler is not part of the box.

boxRows.description: Number of horizontal rows of slots, counted from the TOP edge of the image to the bottom. Count exactly as the image is displayed: never rotate or flip the box in your head, and ignore which way any printed text (e.g. the slogan on the rim) faces.

boxColumns.description: Number of vertical columns of slots, counted from the LEFT edge of the image to the right. Count exactly as the image is displayed: never rotate or flip the box in your head, and ignore which way any printed text (e.g. the slogan on the rim) faces.

gridLeft.description: Position of the LEFT edge of the grid of praline slots (outer edge of the outermost slots, not the box rim), as a percentage 0-100 of the image width, measured from the left of the image as displayed. The photo has a white margin with a 0-100 RULER on all four sides: 0 = photo's left/top edge, 100 = right/bottom edge. Read the value off the ruler.

gridTop.description: Position of the TOP edge of the grid of praline slots (outer edge of the outermost slots, not the box rim), as a percentage 0-100 of the image height, measured from the top of the image as displayed. The photo has a white margin with a 0-100 RULER on all four sides: 0 = photo's left/top edge, 100 = right/bottom edge. Read the value off the ruler.

gridRight.description: Position of the RIGHT edge of the grid of praline slots (outer edge of the outermost slots, not the box rim), as a percentage 0-100 of the image width, measured from the left of the image as displayed. The photo has a white margin with a 0-100 RULER on all four sides: 0 = photo's left/top edge, 100 = right/bottom edge. Read the value off the ruler.

gridBottom.description: Position of the BOTTOM edge of the grid of praline slots (outer edge of the outermost slots, not the box rim), as a percentage 0-100 of the image height, measured from the top of the image as displayed. The photo has a white margin with a 0-100 RULER on all four sides: 0 = photo's left/top edge, 100 = right/bottom edge. Read the value off the ruler.
